sermon.title: The Serpent — December 13, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: At Christmas, Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the serpent. Satan masquerades as an angel of light and questioned God’s word, yet God’s plan was at work. Cain was rejected for his behavior, not his offering, and was told to rule over sin. The devil was a murderer from the beginning, but Jesus destroyed his power through death.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

faqs.question: How does Satan appear?
faqs.answer: He masquerades as an angel of light; he is not really a messenger of God.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But He turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you are not mindful of the things of God, but the things of men.”

faqs.question: What did God tell Cain?
faqs.answer: Do well — do good, don’t do evil, don’t harm others.

faqs.question: Why are people deceived?
faqs.answer: He deceives the simple and unlearned; my people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.
